implemented: CostSchedule selects the latest segment rule effective on the trade date and refuses missing prior rules or duplicate effective dates.

limitations: Rates in the focused tests are explicitly synthetic fixtures; current broker/exchange fee schedules need owner-supplied verification before use as calibrated cost inputs.
